description: Task completion review (#2016). Answers whether the evidence supports declaring one task DONE. Absent test evidence degrades the completion judgment instead of skipping it, because an absence of tests is itself part of the answer.

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: The task and its acceptance statement.

inputs.name: diff
inputs.description: The change claimed to complete the task.

inputs.name: tests
inputs.description: Test evidence. Optional: absence degrades the completion judgment.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.description: The plan the task belongs to. Optional: absence skips the task-versus-plan cross-check.

steps.description: Missing `tasks` or `diff` stops here (both required inputs).
Task against the plan it belongs to.
Without test evidence this runs in a reduced form and records the degradation.
